title: Chapter 2888 - 154: Wujiu Vulture Dragon Pattern_3
content:
Chapter 2888: Chapter 154: Wujiu Vulture Dragon Pattern_3

This way, it will be a once-and-for-all solution, completely extinguishing the hope of the Witch Vulture tribe’s godly descent and crushing their ambitions.

He hadn’t mentioned this to anyone, just wanting to resolve it with one arrow.

And as Chief Dan Lie bent the bow and drew the arrow, tens of thousands of flames converged on the Vermilion Bird’s long bow, transforming into a fiery arrow, accompanied by the clear cry of the Vermilion Bird, exuding an astonishing might.

The moment this arrow appeared, the aura of flames emanated, and the Young Master of Witch Vulture immediately changed color.

The other Wujiu Vulture Generals also showed expressions of shock.

"Stop him!"

The Young Master of Witch Vulture shouted sharply, then his figure flickered and he was the first to block in front of Chief Dan Lie and the Black Vulture Elder who was ascending the Divine Altar.

The other Wujiu Vulture Generals also stepped forward to intercept.

But they were, after all, a moment too late.

Chief Dan Lie, this arrow was unexpected and quick to strike without a word of nonsense, only saying at the last moment of exertion:

"Die!"

Then the cry of the Vermilion Bird was shrill, and tens of thousands of flames were forged into a red light, bursting forth in an instant.

The Vermilion Bird’s arrow cut through the air, drawing a long line of fire in the sky, heading straight for the Black Vulture Elder.

Two Wujiu Vulture Generals tried to block it, but were directly pierced through the chest.

The Young Master of Witch Vulture, with incredible perception, predicted the trajectory of the Vermilion Bird’s arrow in the blink of an eye, transformed his right hand into a dragon claw, and clenched it hard, surprisingly managing to hold the Vermilion Bird’s arrow.

But he could only hold it for a moment.

The next instant, as the fire exploded, the long arrow, like the feather of the Vermilion Bird, carried an unstoppable force, piercing through his palm.

It even broke through his dragon scales, tore open his dragon claw, and even his palm was scorched by the fiery fire.

This was almost the first time his dragon-transformed body was injured in this battle.

The Young Master of Witch Vulture was furious, but he couldn’t care about so much now because the Black Vulture Elder, as a shaman, could not die yet.

At least not now.

The Young Master of Witch Vulture hastily turned his head and saw the Vermilion Bird’s arrow, with blazing fire, heading straight for the Black Vulture Elder.

The Black Vulture Elder, as a shaman, could foresee disaster, and should have been able to dodge it.

But now, he was ascending the ancient Divine Altar, surrounded by Vermilion Bird Fire that could burn divine thought.

He must constantly activate the Divine Path Skill, summoning the protection of the Wujiu Great God to withstand the pressure and ascend the steps of the Divine Way step by step.

Chief Dan Lie’s prediction was also very precise.

The Black Vulture Elder clearly didn’t have the strength now to dodge this killer move, like Danque Flowing Fire.

But as the shaman in charge of the godly descent’s overall situation for the Wujiu tribe, the Black Vulture Elder was by no means an ordinary person.

His body suddenly "decayed," transforming into a "rotten skin," with a mix of foul-smelling Witch Vulture feathers on it.

The Witch Vulture feeds on decay, capable of transforming into rotting flesh.

This rotten skin instantly inflated, forming a barrier that wrapped the Black Vulture Elder in the middle.

Then the Vermilion Bird arrow struck the elder’s decayed flesh, and as the fiery flow surged, it almost burned his rotten body completely clean.

The power of this Vermilion Bird’s arrow, in terms of its burning and killing might, was evident.

But after all the obstacles from the Wujiu Generals and the Young Master, its force was diminished, and its power weakened slightly in its final stretch.

This Vermilion Bird’s arrow did not truly kill the Black Vulture Elder.

Amid the scattering black feathers, the remaining rotten flesh squirmed and transformed back into the elder.

But at this point, the elder had half of his body "evaporated."

The Black Vulture Elder turned around, using a pitch-black eye socket to glare at Chief Dan Lie with a gaze that wished to tear him into pieces.

But at this moment, God Descent was the priority, and time was of the essence.

The Black Vulture Elder held back his fury and, with a body in fragments, continued to climb the Divine Altar step by step, with unwavering perseverance, to summon the descent of his Witch Vulture God.

As long as the Witch Vulture God descends, he can realize his vision, letting all enemies of the Divine Way die in a sea of decay, with their divine souls extinguished...
